chapter: Maple Leaf, own orchestra and rivals
title: Silver Leaf as Robichaux's second band; replacing Piron at teas
summary: He says the Silver Leaf was second band to Robichaux and Charles's orchestra was Piron's second band, taking his place at teas.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: No, I never played with John in no time. At no time.
No time. I never played with John. Did he give you much work? Oh yeah.
We were supposed to be second band, the Silver League band.

Just like Charles' orchestra was Pierrot's second band. I see. Because Pierrot, you see when he left and went to New York, I'm the one who took his place playing those, do you remember, I was standing at afternoon teas where nobody else played there with him but him. Pierrot was the only one who played the afternoon tea. He used to do a string instrument, you see, nothing but string.
Well first was the Silver Leaf, and then was which? The Maple Leaf. Then Charles' orchestra. And you joined the Maple Leaf about what time?
